artistSources: pokemon-card.com official Japanese card database (36 JP-market cards)
notes: languages = languages Cardmarket actually lists offers in for that product; it is marketplace availability, not an official print-run manifest.
cardKey = Cardmarket Versions grouping (card name + attack names). Same cardKey = same card text, NOT necessarily same artwork.
variantToken = Cardmarket -V1/-V2/-V3 slug, used to separate distinct printings sharing a collector number.
variantAxes = filters Cardmarket exposes for the product (Reverse Holo / First Edition indicate those variants exist).

artist coverage is 115/198: English-market releases from pokemontcg.io/limitlesstcg, Japanese-market releases from the official pokemon-card.com database. Remaining nulls are mostly Korean/Chinese deck products with no published illustrator credit.

verification.description: Every card x language x variant claim was checked against sources outside Cardmarket. See verification/RESUME.md.
